player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id}. You are playing Guess The Number.
You have to guess the number between {min_number} and {max_number} within {max_turns} turns.
As you enter your guess, the game will provide you with hints such as 'higher' or 'lower'.
You may provide your response in any manner. Only the number that is wrapped in square brackets will be considered as your guess. For example, [5].
As you play, the history of your guesses will be appended below. Use the information to complete the game before you run out of guesses.
Enter your guess.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Fomu ya kufanya move si sahihi. Mchezaji {player_id} hakujibu kwa '[number]' halali.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Chinthu chambura kwenelera. Woseŵera {player_id} waghanaghana nambala iyo yikupambana na ya mu malo agho wapika.
invalid_move.already_guessed: Chinthu chambura kwenelera. Woseŵera {player_id} waghanaghana kale nambara yake.

game_message.target_higher: Nambara ya awo ŵakukhumba kukomeka yili pacanya.
game_message.target_lower: Nambara ya awo ŵakukhumba kukomeka yili pasi.

outcome.win: Wacita makora, ndipo wakumanya nadi unandi wa ŵanthu awo ŵakukoma.
